pharm: JAK2 and IRAK1 inhibitor for myelofibrosis with severe thrombocytopenia (platelets below 50 x 10^9/L); boxed warnings for mortality, MACE, thrombosis and malignancy
quick: Can cause fetal harm; verify status; effective contraception during and after treatment per labeling
Do not breastfeed during treatment and after last dose per labeling
See full labeling; monitor renal function with diarrhoea/vomiting/dehydration risk
See full labeling; dose-reduce in moderate-severe impairment for hepatically cleared agents
No specific interaction; avoid excess with hepatotoxic or myelosuppressive therapy
CBC, LFTs, drug-specific toxicities, pregnancy status
summary: Pacritinib (Vonjo) is indicated for intermediate/high-risk primary or secondary myelofibrosis with severe thrombocytopenia (platelets below 50 x 10^9/L), the population other JAK inhibitors worsen. It inhibits JAK2 and IRAK1. Boxed warnings cover all-cause mortality, major cardiovascular events, thrombosis and secondary malignancies; other risks are bleeding, diarrhoea, QT prolongation and embryo-fetal toxicity.
indications: Intermediate- or high-risk primary or secondary myelofibrosis with severe thrombocytopenia (platelet count below 50 x 10^9/L)

dosage.t: With or without food; swallow whole
dosage.n: Avoid in moderate-severe hepatic impairment; hold for active bleeding, QTc over 480 ms or severe diarrhoea

admin: Take exactly as prescribed; do not crush, split or chew unless labeling allows
Take at the same time(s) each day; if a dose is missed follow the missed-dose rule - do not double
Report interacting new medicines including antifungals, anti-TB drugs, antiepileptics and St John's wort (CYP3A4)
Store in the original container with desiccant where supplied; protect from moisture
moa: Pacritinib inhibits JAK2 (myelofibrosis proliferation and symptoms) and IRAK1 (inflammatory signalling), retaining activity in severe thrombocytopenia where myelosuppressive JAK inhibition is otherwise limiting.

relative: Active bleeding or high bleeding risk (thrombocytopenic population)

preg: No adequate human data. Based on mechanism, fetal harm is expected. Verify pregnancy status before starting; advise effective contraception during treatment and for the specified period after the last dose. Use in pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential fetal risk.
lact: No data on presence in human milk. Because of potential serious adverse reactions in the breastfed infant, advise women not to breastfeed during treatment and for the specified period after the last dose.
renal: Mild-moderate impairment: no routine change unless labeled; severe: limited data - monitor for exaggerated toxicity and dehydration-related AKI.
hepatic: Mild impairment: monitor; moderate-severe: dose-reduce or avoid per labeling (most agents hepatically cleared).

major: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers (marked exposure changes - avoid combination per labeling)
interactions.alcohol: Avoid excess alcohol with hepatotoxic therapy.
interactions.diagnostics: No characteristic laboratory test interference; monitor disease-specific markers.

emergency: Fainting, palpitations or seizures (possible arrhythmia) - seek emergency care
Chest pain or sudden breathlessness/leg swelling (clot) - seek emergency care

counsel: Bleeding risk is high because platelets are already low - report any bleeding, black stools or severe bruising
Diarrhoea is common early - keep hydrated and call if persistent
Report fainting, palpitations, chest pain, leg swelling or breathlessness at once
Attend heart-tracing (ECG) and blood-count visits; use contraception
pk: Target inhibition within hours-days; response assessed in weeks
Room temperature 20-25 C in original container; protect from moisture
pearls: Designed for platelets below 50, where ruxolitinib/fedratinib are problematic - do not switch populations casually
QT monitoring is mandatory (baseline and periodic ECGs)
Carries the full JAK-class boxed quartet (mortality, MACE, thrombosis, malignancy)
missed: Take the missed dose as soon as remembered on the same day unless it is near the next dose; never double up. Take as soon as remembered on the same day unless near the next dose; do not double.
overdose: No specific antidote. Withhold drug and give supportive care with monitoring of CBC, ECG, LFTs and agent-specific toxicities. Contact Poison Help (1-800-222-1222).
